sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, raw x/y centroid, fill colour) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/royal-caribbean/freedom-of-the-seas/v2493/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg), one .cabinShape[data-cabin] rect per stateroom. SVGs fetched by plain curl of deckmaps' own asset path (HTTP 200); no header spoofing or bot-wall evasion. Category legend built by mapping each of the 27 distinct fill colours to a Royal Caribbean Freedom-class stateroom category, with every colour ground-truthed against >=1 cruisedeckplans.com cabin (stateroom-details / category-detail pages) and cross-checked against exact per-category cabin counts.

notes.completeness: FULL grid: every stateroom on every guest deck (decks 2,3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12). Decks 4,5,13,14,15 and public areas carry no staterooms in the source. Total 1962 matches deckmaps' advertised count exactly (zero duplicate cabin numbers). cruisedeckplans lists ~2011 across its category pages; the ~49 difference is accessible/connecting rows the two sources count differently.
notes.category: deckmaps encodes category only via cabin fill colour. 27 distinct fills map to 15 Royal Caribbean Freedom-class categories (several categories use more than one colour shade). Each fill was verified against a real cruisedeckplans cabin of that colour. See colorLegend. Note: deckmaps and cruisedeckplans draw the Balcony vs Spacious Balcony boundary slightly differently, so those two counts do not reconcile perfectly with cruisedeckplans totals even though every representative cabin matched.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. Length axis is the SVG y-axis with the bow at low y (confirmed by the forward Panoramic Suites 1804/1854 at low y and the aft Grand Suites at max y); section = forward/mid/aft thirds of each deck's y-range. Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED heuristic. The beam is the SVG x-axis; side = geometric split of each deck's cabins at the beam centreline (low x = port, high x = starboard). Interior cabins near the centreline and the whole labelling could be uniformly mirrored; validate against a known cabin before relying on it.
notes.obstructed: deckmaps SVGs carry no obstructed-view flag; obstructed=false for all (source does not encode obstruction, not asserted as clear-view).
